messages:
Priya S.: FYI saw odd behavior in the python onboarding sample when combining prefetch=2 + concurrency=5. we get a repeating 429 pattern every ~3s.
Liam O.: can you paste minimal repro and logs?
Priya S.: run: `python examples/onboard.py --workers 5 --prefetch 2 --mode embeds_paginate` logs: ```2024-07-08T16:02:11Z WARN tokenbucket empty worker=3 refill_ms=200
2024-07-08T16:02:14Z ERROR request failed status=429 route=/v1/embeds Retry-After=3
2024-07-08T16:02:14Z INFO backoff set global_until=2024-07-08T16:02:17Z
2024-07-08T16:02:17Z ERROR request failed status=429 route=/v1/embeds Retry-After=3
```
Yara B.: hmm looks like a shared global backoff + prefetch causing waves. did sample app honor per-response Retry-After or just set a single shared timestamp?
Priya S.: it used a global shared backoff. patched locally to per-worker backoffs and added small jitter when clearing. that mostly fixed it. config I used: `client = RedwoodClient(concurrency=5, prefetch=1, refill_interval_ms=80, refill_jitter_ms=60)`
Liam O.: good catch. also check that our python SDK refill implementation doesn't hold a lock during auth refresh. blocking refresh -> synchronized refill -> bursts.
Priya S.: confirmed: refresh held the refill lock in our older SDK version. quick fix was to make auth refresh non-blocking and do atomic token swap.
Liam O.: long-term: we should align SDK semantics: token-bucket with per-worker reservations for pagination, jittered refill, non-blocking auth, and explicit guidance in onboarding doc.
Priya S.: opened py-sdk PR: `py-sdk#3781` with token-bucket+jitter + unit tests; added integration test in devex harness that runs 5 workers x prefetch=2 against mock endpoint that returns Retry-After=2.
Ops-Bot: ci queued: devex/integration/throttle-compat (build 12045) :white_check_mark:
Yara B.: can we also add short onboarding note: "If using prefetch or >4 workers, set prefetch <=1 or increase refill_jitter_ms >=50 and ensure SDK >=0.13.2." many users copy sample configs.
Priya S.: added docs PR and updated examples/onboard/README with recommended defaults and a reproducer script under `examples/onboard/prefetch-repro`. tagging @Liam O. and @Yara B. for review. :thumbsup:
